name: Businesses in ChatGPT
desc: Claim your business in ChatGPT and run a Business Agent for it.
desc_zh: 在 ChatGPT 里认领你的企业，并为它运行一个 Business Agent。
solves: A business has no way to correct what ChatGPT says about it. Business Hub lets you claim the listing, publish a product feed, and see the mentions and clicks you get.
solves_zh: 企业无法纠正 ChatGPT 对自己的说法。Business Hub 让你认领条目、发布商品数据，并看到获得的提及和点击。
best_for: People are asking ChatGPT about your products and getting the wrong answer.
best_for_zh: 潜在客户都在问 ChatGPT 你的产品，而它一次又一次答得不对。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes and OpenAI news）。 Two surfaces: Business Hub (claim, product feed, insights) and Business Agents (customer-facing chat). The ChatGPT release notes carry the same launch under the heading "Business Hub in ChatGPT", dated November 10, 2026. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-businesses-chatgpt
